Root 30700 composes text widgets 6181, 6182, 6183 and 6184 plus widget 4892. Its packet-driven layout supports one, two, three or four Strings and repositions the active lines before finalizing the same root.

The class embeds widget 14171 and configures it through rs/n/c/A.a(...), whose exact implementation resolves rs/d/k.f(itemId) and uses that definition's model-scale data when constructing the widget content. The default build also configures 14171 with item id 21235.
